: Hi!
: Hey, Ami. Are you walking on water right-
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ami。你是走在水面上——

lines.en: : Thanks for coming to my special bonus scene, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你来参加我的特别奖励场景，Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t even want to {i}try{/i} explaining how long I’ve been waiting here for you.
lines.zh: : 我甚至都不想{i}尝试{/i}解释，我在这儿等了你多久。

lines.en: : Then don’t. You are a human being and have the right to exercise free will the same way as everyone else.
lines.zh: : 那就别解释。你也是人类，有权利和其他所有人一样行使自由意志。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : About which part?
lines.zh: : 确定哪一部分？

lines.en: : Anyway, I’m glad you’re here. The only thing is that you decided to show up at the worst possible time.
lines.zh: : 总之，我很高兴你来了。唯一的问题是，你挑了最糟糕的时机出现。

lines.en: : You see, I just invited a few other people over since I gave up on you ever making it!
lines.zh: : 你看，我刚才因为已经放弃你会来了，就顺手邀请了另外几个人过来！

lines.en: : Is it anyone I know?
lines.zh: : 是我认识的人吗？

lines.en: : If not, something must have gone very wrong!
lines.zh: : 如果不是，那一定是哪里出了大问题！

lines.en: if goodboy == False:
: In fact, I’m going to flag your save file with the cheater flag right now since you clearly only found your way here thanks to somebody else!
lines.zh: : 事实上，我现在就要给你的存档文件打上作弊者标记，因为你显然是靠着别人才找到这里来的！

lines.en: $ cheater = True
: What does the cheater flag do?
lines.zh: : 作弊者标记会怎么样？

lines.en: : That’s for me to know and you to find out!
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，我知道就好，你自己去发现吧！

lines.en: : Just kidding, I don’t know what it does.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的，我也不知道它会怎么样。

lines.en: : I’m a normal [teenage]girl, just like Maya!
lines.zh: : 我是个普通的 [teenage] 女孩，就像 Maya 一样！

lines.en: : I’ll still love you even if you’re a cheater, Sensei. You don’t have to worry.
lines.zh: : 就算你是作弊者，我也一样爱你，Sensei。你不用担心。

lines.en: else:
: I just double checked and it looks like you’re okay, though. So yeah, it’s safe to assume you know everyone coming.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚又确认了一遍，看起来你没事。所以没错，可以安全地认为，来的人你都认识。

lines.en: : Or at least two of them. The third one’s a bit of a sticky situation.
lines.zh: : 或者至少认识其中两个。第三个嘛，就有点棘手了。

lines.en: : Sticky like-
lines.zh: : 棘手得像——

lines.en: : Marshmallows?
lines.zh: : 棉花糖？

lines.en: : You know me so well, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你可真了解我，Ami。

lines.en: : Of course I do! I know you better than anyone. But of course I have an unfair advantage since I’ve been with you all this time.
lines.zh: : 那当然！我比任何人都了解你。不过话说回来，我确实占了不公平的优势，因为这段时间我一直都陪在你身边。

lines.en: : But yeah! They should be showing up any minute now.
lines.zh: : 总之！她们随时都可能出现。

lines.en: : I really hope you don’t mind having to share the bonus scene with them, Sensei. If I had known you were going to win the lottery, I would have set aside some extra time!
lines.zh: : 我真的希望你别介意要和她们分享这个奖励场景，Sensei。要是我早知道你会中彩票，我一定会多留出一些时间的！

lines.en: Ami inadvertently kicks some water up at me and gets my swimsuit all soggy.
lines.zh: Ami 无意间朝我踢起一阵水花，把我的泳衣弄得湿透了。

lines.en: Wait a second, when did I put on my swimsuit?
lines.zh: 等等，我是什么时候换上泳衣的？

lines.en: scene amibonusround2
: Is something wrong, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 有什么不对劲吗，[amimaster]？

lines.en: : Nope. Just a little confused about how things are always so convenient when you’re around.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是有点困惑，为什么只要有你在，一切都总是这么顺理成章。

lines.en: : I’d sure hope they are. I practiced very hard to make your life as easy as possible.
lines.zh: : 我当然希望是这样。我可是非常努力地练习过，就为了让你的生活尽可能轻松。

lines.en: : Which is probably why it makes me just a {i}little{/i} bit mad when you cum inside of my friends.
lines.zh: : 大概也正因为如此，当你射在我朋友身体里的时候，我才会有{i}一点点{/i}生气。

lines.en: : But I’m not going to bog down this special occasion with petty drama like that! That’s what chapter three is for!
lines.zh: : 不过我可不会用这种小家子气的破事来搅坏这个特别的场合！那种事是留给第三章的！

lines.en: : While you’re {i}here{/i}, everything is supposed to be perfectly fine and perfectly normal! Which is why I’m in my bathing suit!
lines.zh: : 你{i}在这里{/i}的时候，一切都应该完美无缺、完全正常！所以我才穿着泳衣！

lines.en: : Sorry I couldn’t bring the Hello Kitty one. I played with myself too many times while wearing it because of how cute I looked and now it’s kind of ruined.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我没能穿上那件 Hello Kitty 的。我穿着它自慰了太多次，因为穿上它实在太可爱了，现在它已经有点不行了。

lines.en: : It’s okay, Ami. I will buy you a new one since you are my favorite character and so pretty.
lines.zh: : 没关系，Ami。我会给你买一件新的，因为你是我最喜欢的角色，而且那么漂亮。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei! I’m so glad that you said that without me having to make you!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei！我真高兴这句话是你自己说的，而不是我逼你说的！

lines.en: : Of course, Ami. You are my favorite character and so pretty.
lines.zh: : 当然，Ami。你是我最喜欢的角色，而且那么漂亮。

lines.en: : Awww, stop it!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别说了啦！

lines.en: : Okay.
: Nononono. Don’t stop. I was just trying to be humble since it is a character trait I lack and I have to climb back up the rankings.
lines.zh: : 不不不不不。别说停。我刚才只是想表现得谦虚一点，因为谦虚是我缺少的角色特质，我得爬回排行榜上去。

lines.en: : I don’t understand what you want from me.
lines.zh: : 我不明白你到底想让我怎样。

lines.en: : Neither do I sometimes! So just give me everything and I’m sure it will all be okay.
lines.zh: : 有时候连我自己也不明白！所以你只要把一切都给我，我相信一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : Oh! The bell of the door!
lines.zh: : 哦！门口的铃响了！

lines.en: : Those must be our guests!
lines.zh: : 一定是我们的客人来了！

lines.en: : Come on, Sensei! We need to let them in!
lines.zh: : 快点，Sensei！我们得去给她们开门！

lines.en: scene black
Ami slides across the water like she’s ice skating. But she’s also rapidly rotating while doing this, so it looks kind of like a helicopter trying to break through an invisible barrier to swim.
lines.zh: Ami 像滑冰一样在水面上滑了过去。不过她一边滑还一边飞快地旋转，所以看起来有点像一架直升机正试图冲破一道看不见的屏障去游泳。

lines.en: My swimsuit gets even soggier so I decide to just jump into the water so our guests don’t think I am rude.
lines.zh: 我的泳衣变得更湿了，于是我决定干脆跳进水里，免得客人们觉得我没礼貌。

lines.en: The bell of the door rings again and Ami kicks a special button that only she can see in order to open a secret passageway concealed behind an invisible bookshelf.
lines.zh: 门口的铃声又响了起来，Ami 踢了一下只有她能看见的专用按钮，打开了一条藏在隐形书架后面的秘密通道。

lines.en: Kind of like the one in my room that I completely forgot about until right now!
lines.zh: 有点像我房间里那条——直到刚才我才彻底想起来！

lines.en: : Sensei! Stop thinking things that will only further confuse anyone listening in and help me open the door!
lines.zh: : Sensei！别再想那些只会让偷听的人更加困惑的事情了，快来帮我开门！

lines.en: : Sorry, Ami. I didn’t realize you needed my help. You are so independent and pretty and also my favorite character.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami。我不知道你需要我帮忙。你是这么独立、这么漂亮，而且还是我最喜欢的角色。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Thanks!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 谢谢！

lines.en: I stop thinking things that will only further confuse anyone listening in and help Ami open the door.
lines.zh: 我不再去想那些只会让偷听的人更加困惑的事情，转而帮 Ami 开门。

lines.en: Once we get it off the ground (It’s one of those vertically opening doors), a few shadows crawl through and I realize that we might be in for some scares.
lines.zh: 等我们把它从地上抬起来（就是那种向上开启的门），几个影子爬了进来，我这才意识到，我们恐怕要被吓一跳了。

lines.en: scene amibonusround3
Just kidding! Looks like Ami invited over Sara, Sara with an N, and [[DECEASED THIRD FAMILY MEMBER].
lines.zh: 开玩笑的！看来 Ami 请来的是 Sara、带 N 的 Sara，还有[[已故的第三位家庭成员]。

lines.en: : Hey! I didn’t realize you also made it to the special bonus Ami round, Sensei! If I had known, I would have worn something a little sexier.
lines.zh: : 嘿！我还不知道你也闯进了 Ami 的特别奖励回合呢，Sensei！早知道的话，我就穿得性感一点了。

lines.en: : (Dolphin noises)
lines.zh: : （海豚的声音）

lines.en: : I just made it here for the first time. Isn’t Ami so great?
lines.zh: : 我也是第一次来到这儿。Ami 是不是特别棒？

lines.en: : She really is!
lines.zh: : 她确实是的！

lines.en: : Hiya, Sara! You look just as beautiful as ever!
lines.zh: : 嗨呀，Sara！你还是和以前一样漂亮！

lines.en: : Aww~ Thank you, Ami. I wish I had a daughter as perfect as you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀~ 谢谢你，Ami。我真希望自己能有一个像你这样完美的女儿。

lines.en: : (Dolphin noises)
lines.zh: : （海豚的声音）

lines.en: : So, are you guys ready to go swimming? Since we have extra people here, I might be able to actually get {i}inside{/i} the water this time instead of just on top of it!
lines.zh: : 那么，你们准备好去游泳了吗？既然这儿多了几个人，说不定这次我真的能{i}进到水里{/i}去，而不是只能待在水面上！

lines.en: : Sensei, can you help me push Ami’s gorgeous, pubescent body into the water? I am but a weak, insignificant female character who is unable to do it on my own!
lines.zh: : Sensei，你能帮我把 Ami 那具美妙的、正值青春期的身体推进水里吗？我只是个柔弱无足轻重的女性角色，一个人可办不到！

lines.en: : Of course, Sara. Anything for you, Sana, and-
lines.zh: : 当然，Sara。为了你、Sana，还有——

lines.en: : Woah! Hold on there, Sensei! Sara will cry if you mention him! She’s already been through enough, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 哇哦！等等，Sensei！你要是提到他，Sara 会哭的！她已经受够了吧，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : (Dolphin noises)
lines.zh: : （海豚的声音）

lines.en: : Sana, stop that.
lines.zh: : Sana，别那样了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Mom...
lines.zh: : 对不起，妈妈……

lines.en: scene black
I help push Ami into the water with Sara’s help.
lines.zh: 在 Sara 的帮助下，我把 Ami 推进了水里。

lines.en: The two of us share a prolonged exchange of eye contact where I think I’m supposed to want to kiss her, but all I can really think about is kissing Ami instead.
lines.zh: 我们俩长时间地对视着，我想，此刻我应该想要吻她才对，可我满脑子真的只想吻 Ami。

lines.en: Anyway, the push is successful!
lines.zh: 总之，推成功了！

lines.en: We did it!
lines.zh: 我们做到了！

lines.en: Now, Ami is free to swim once again and I am free to have a fun adult conversation with one of my top ten favorite moms.
lines.zh: 现在，Ami 终于可以自由自在地游泳了，而我也终于可以和我最爱的十位妈妈之一，来一场愉快的成人对话了。

lines.en: scene amibonusround4
: So, Sara...do you come here often?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sara……你常来这儿吗？

lines.en: : Yes, actually! It used to be a weekly thing, but now it’s really only when I’m feeling a little under the weather.
lines.zh: : 是的，真的！以前是一个星期一次，不过现在基本上只有我身体不太舒服的时候才来。

lines.en: : I normally take Sana along with me since I’m ditzy and get lost on occasion, but she doesn’t really seem to mind.
lines.zh: : 我一般会带上 Sana，因为我有点迷糊，偶尔会走丢，不过她好像也不介意。

lines.en: : In fact, she normally just sits there and watches Ami and I play together.
lines.zh: : 事实上，她通常就坐在那儿，看着我和 Ami 一起玩。

lines.en: : What kind of games do you play?
lines.zh: : 你们都玩些什么游戏？

lines.en: : Do you know the one where two people have to get inside of a potato sack and hop around?
lines.zh: : 你知道那种两个人钻进麻袋里蹦来蹦去的游戏吗？

lines.en: : Yes, I know the hopping potato sack game.
lines.zh: : 知道，我知道那个麻袋跳的游戏。

lines.en: : Well, that’s one we have never played before. I look forward to it every time, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个我们从来没玩过。不过我每次都很期待。

lines.en: : Games where I can blame someone else for what goes wrong and avoid having to accept failure are always my favorite.
lines.zh: : 那种可以把出了岔子的事怪到别人头上、自己不用承担失败的游戏，永远是我的最爱。

lines.en: : Sana, why are you wearing your Halloween costume in the pool? That can’t possibly be comfortable.
lines.zh: : Sana，你为什么穿着万圣节服装在泳池里？那样肯定不舒服吧。

lines.en: : I’m...not wearing anything underneath it...and...um...
lines.zh: : 我……里面什么都没穿……而且……嗯……

lines.en: : Got it. Yeah, we can’t have you naked in the pool. It will take away some of the focus from me and-
lines.zh: : 明白了。是啊，我们可不能让你光着身子待在泳池里。那会分走一些本该属于我的注意力，而且——

lines.en: scene amibonusround6
: Hey, wait a second! This is a bonus {i}Ami{/i} scene! Why are you paying more attention to Sara than me?!
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下！这可是 {i}Ami{/i} 的奖励场景！你为什么对 Sara 的注意力比对我还多？！

lines.en: : Sorry, Ami! I was just so excited to see Sensei here that we must have-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami！我只是看到 Sensei 在这儿太兴奋了，所以我们一定是一不小心——

lines.en: : Unforgivable! You’re here because I need a mother figure! Not because Sensei needs a hot MILF to cuck me with! Damn you, Sara!
lines.zh: : 不可原谅！你是因为我需要一位母亲般的人选才来的！不是因为 Sensei 需要一个火辣的熟女来给我戴绿帽子！可恶，Sara！

lines.en: scene amibonusround5
: Sorry, Sensei. I [[CENSORED BY AMI ARAKAWA] you, but if you’re going to MAKE LOVE to anyone here, it’s going to have to be Ami.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sensei。我[[由 AMI ARAKAWA 审查删除]你，不过如果你打算在这里和谁做爱，那只能是 Ami。

lines.en: : But she is so pretty and I will not perform well because I’ll be nervous.
lines.zh: : 可她是那么漂亮，我一定会紧张得表现不好。

lines.en: : That’s okay, Sensei! We can practice over and over and over and over and-
lines.zh: : 没关系，Sensei！我们可以一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍地练习——

lines.en: : Over and over and over and over!
lines.zh: : 一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍！

lines.en: : See! Sara gets it!
lines.zh: : 看吧！Sara 都懂！

lines.en: : Maybe some other time then, Sara.
lines.zh: : 那还是改天吧，Sara。

lines.en: scene amibonusround7
: AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!! NO!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！不要！！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: : ONLY ME!
lines.zh: : 只能是我！

lines.en: : Sensei! Look what you’ve done to poor little, Ami!
lines.zh: : Sensei！看看你把可怜的小 Ami 弄成什么样了！

lines.en: : Her {b}MOM DIED{/b}, you know! You have to be nice to her!
lines.zh: : 她的{b}妈妈可是死了{/b}，你知道的！你必须对她好一点！

lines.en: : Sorry, Ami. I didn’t think the future was off limits too.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami。我不知道连未来也是禁区。

lines.en: : There is no future! Not with an everlooping two season cycle in which you fall in love with everyone else! And that includes Sara!
lines.zh: : 没有未来！在一个永远循环的两季轮回里，你会爱上其他所有人，哪来的未来！其中还包括 Sara！

lines.en: : I will have to share some of my inner monologues with you soon, Ami. They fully support the fact that I am not entirely capable of love and that you may have less to worry about than you believe!
lines.zh: : 我得找个时间把我的一些内心独白分享给你，Ami。它们完全可以证明，我根本没有完全爱上别人的能力，所以你要担心的，也许比你以为的要少得多！

lines.en: : Enough! Stop the music!
lines.zh: : 够了！把音乐停下！

lines.en: : I thought inviting the Sakakibaras would be fun, but I can see now that I have made a horrible mistake!
lines.zh: : 我本来以为邀请 Sakakibara 家的人来会很好玩，可现在我明白了，我犯下了一个可怕的错误！

lines.en: : (Dolphin noises)
lines.zh: : （海豚的声音）

lines.en: : Hm? Where did Sana just-
lines.zh: : 嗯？Sana 刚才去哪——

lines.en: Sara disappears.
lines.zh: Sara 消失了。

lines.en: There is no third pop since the last Sakakibara is already gone.
lines.zh: 没有第三声「啵」，因为最后一位 Sakakibara 早就已经不在了。

lines.en: : Was that really necessary, Ami?
lines.zh: : 真的有必要做到这一步吗，Ami？

lines.en: scene amispecial1x
scene amispecial2x
scene amispecial3x
scene amibonusround8
: Of course it was. This is the special Ami bonus scene. I am Ami. This is my scene. Is it not special to you?
lines.zh: : 当然有必要。这是 Ami 的特别奖励场景。我是 Ami。这是我的场景。难道它对你来说不够特别吗？

lines.en: : You were the one who invited them, though.
lines.zh: : 可明明是你自己邀请她们来的。

lines.en: : Which means I’m allowed to uninvite them as well.
lines.zh: : 那也就意味着，我同样有权把她们请出去。

lines.en: : You need to pay more attention to me, Sensei. If you don’t, really bad things are going to happen.
lines.zh: : 你得把更多注意力放在我身上，Sensei。如果你不这么做，非常糟糕的事情就要发生了。

lines.en: : And I mean {i}really{/i} bad.
lines.zh: : 我是说，{i}非常非常{/i}糟糕。

lines.en: : What kind of bad are you talking about exactly?...
lines.zh: : 你说的到底是哪种糟糕？……

lines.en: : That’s a secret.
lines.zh: : 这是秘密。

lines.en: scene black
Ami pops along with the world around her and I am suddenly stranded in a dark abyss.
lines.zh: Ami 连同她周围的世界一起「啵」的一声消失了，我忽然被抛在一片黑暗的深渊里。

lines.en: The pressure due to a lack of color begins to adjust my ribcage.
lines.zh: 由于失去色彩而产生的压力，开始挤压我的胸腔。

lines.en: I can feel the bones pressing down against my lungs, but it’s not as bad as you’d imagine.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到骨头压在肺上，但并不像你想象的那么糟。

lines.en: I envision myself being hugged by my own skeleton.
lines.zh: 我幻想着自己被自己的骨架拥抱着。

lines.en: I am so loved that even my organs can feel it.
lines.zh: 我被爱得如此彻底，连我的内脏都能感觉到。

lines.en: In this moment, I accept whatever comes next.
lines.zh: 在这一刻，我接受了接下来要发生的一切。

lines.en: scene amibonusround9
Anything except this.
lines.zh: 除了这个，什么都行。

lines.en: I wake up at the front of my room and stare at a large egg where I am supposed to be laying.
lines.zh: 我在房间的前面醒来，盯着一颗巨大的蛋——那本该是我躺着的地方。

lines.en: This happens sometimes when I go to sleep too late, but it’s never been much to worry about.
lines.zh: 有时候我睡得太晚就会这样，不过从来都不算什么大问题。

lines.en: I attempt to make my way over to the window only to find that my legs have been replaced with those of a lamb.
lines.zh: 我试图挪到窗边，却发现自己的腿被换成了一头小羊的腿。

lines.en: Having been bred for the express purpose of being sold as veal, I am too weak to walk and my lamb legs feel a little bit like jello.
lines.zh: 作为专门为了当小牛肉卖掉而培育出来的存在，我虚弱得走不动路，而这对羊腿的感觉有点像果冻。

lines.en: Three figures about the same size as a medium house plant dance joyfully near a desk without a computer.
lines.zh: 三个和一株中等大小的室内盆栽差不多高的身影，在一张没有电脑的书桌旁欢快地跳着舞。

lines.en: It sits in an unfamiliar room, but clinging to it is a remarkably familiar atmosphere.
lines.zh: 它坐落在一个陌生的房间里，可萦绕在它周围的，却是一种出奇熟悉的气氛。

lines.en: I breathe in the scent of what I imagine is fresh bread coming from what I imagine is the kitchen.
lines.zh: 我呼吸着那股我想象中来自厨房的新鲜面包香气。

lines.en: I feel whole for the first time since birth.
lines.zh: 自出生以来，我第一次感觉到自己是完整的。

lines.en: scene amibonusround10
: Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 记得微笑！

lines.en: : Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 记得微笑！

lines.en: : Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 记得微笑！

lines.en: The feeling drifts away as if it was never here at all.
lines.zh: 那种感觉飘走了，仿佛它从来不曾存在过。

lines.en: The scent of bread fades as well and is replaced by one much less familiar.
lines.zh: 面包的香气也淡去了，取而代之的是一种陌生得多的气味。

lines.en: Loud footsteps in the attic stomp down on the floor/ceiling above me and disturb the air conditioner in the far corner of the room.
lines.zh: 阁楼里响亮的脚步声踩着我头顶的天花板／地板，惊动了房间远角的那台空调。

lines.en: It shuts off and the temperature rises several degrees almost immediately.
lines.zh: 空调关掉了，温度几乎立刻上升了好几度。

lines.en: And, despite how much I may want to escape, I remain still.
lines.zh: 而尽管我再怎么想逃，我依然一动不动。

lines.en: I curse these lamb legs with all my heart.
lines.zh: 我全心全意地诅咒这对羊腿。

lines.en: : Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 记得微笑！

lines.en: : Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 记得微笑！

lines.en: : Remember to smile!
lines.zh: : 记得微笑！

lines.en: I try.
lines.zh: 我试着微笑。

lines.en: I fail.
lines.zh: 我失败了。

lines.en: scene amibonusround13
: Thank God...
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地……

lines.en: : I didn’t think I’d be able to reach you in here.
lines.zh: : 我本来还以为，我没办法在这儿够到你。
: Ami？……

lines.en: scene amibonusround12
: Um...yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what this is or...even where we are...
lines.zh: : 我不太确定这是什么……甚至不确定我们在哪儿……

lines.en: scene amibonusround11
: But you’re going to be okay.
lines.zh: : 不过你会没事的。

lines.en: : This is all just a dream.
lines.zh: : 这一切都只是一场梦。

lines.en: : Soon, you’ll wake up and be right back in your room.
lines.zh: : 很快，你就会醒来，回到你的房间里。

lines.en: : I’ll be in the kitchen, cooking you a big breakfast and waiting patiently for you to rub the sleep from your eyes.
lines.zh: : 我会在厨房里，给你做一顿丰盛的早餐，然后耐心地等着你揉开眼里的睡意。

lines.en: scene amibonusround12
: All of this, though?
lines.zh: : 可是这一切呢？

lines.en: : These hands...
lines.zh: : 这双手……

lines.en: : These smiles...
lines.zh: : 这些笑容……

lines.en: scene amibonusround13
: Those aren’t me.
lines.zh: : 那些都不是我。

lines.en: : Those will never {i}be{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 那些永远都不会{i}是{/i}我。

lines.en: : And I need you to know that, more than anything else...
lines.zh: : 而我需要你明白，胜过这世上一切的——

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : I will never hurt you.
lines.zh: : 我永远不会伤害你。

lines.en: : I am completely...entirely yours.
lines.zh: : 我完完全全……彻彻底底属于你。

lines.en: scene amibonusround14
: My head-
lines.zh: : 我的头——

lines.en: : Does it hurt?
lines.zh: : 疼吗？

lines.en: : It feels...wrong...
lines.zh: : 感觉……不对劲……

lines.en: scene amibonusround15
: If it feels wrong, it probably is.
lines.zh: : 如果感觉不对劲，那大概就是不对劲。

lines.en: : But...like I said-
lines.zh: : 可是……就像我说的——

lines.en: : I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : To the end of time.
lines.zh: : 直到时间的尽头。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: scene amibonusround16
: Thank you for coming to the special bonus Ami scene.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你来到 Ami 的特别奖励场景。

lines.en: : I really have waited forever.
lines.zh: : 我真的等了好久好久。

lines.en: : But now...
lines.zh: : 不过现在……

lines.en: : It’s time to go back.
lines.zh: : 是时候回去了。

lines.en: : Wait-
lines.zh: : 等等——
